title: All About My Mother (bc30)
synopsis: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels to Barcelona to find the boy's estranged father. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a young nun. As her journeys continue, she gradually picks up the role as a mother again. Hailed as one of his most iconic works, Almodóvar explores the profoundness and fortitude of motherhood in this tragic-comedy infused with the most vibrant colors and cinematic references. To accompany the film's release at the time, bc presented a dedicated retrospective "Desire (Un)Ltd. - All About Almodóvar".

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 單親媽媽曼妞的兒子在生日當天遇車禍喪生，她從兒子的記事簿中得悉他一直盼望與父親相聚，曼妞決定重回故地尋找舊情人，告訴他兒子臨死前的願望。豈料「他」已變成「她」，更染上絕症，有一位修女懷了「她」的孩子。在這趟旅途中，曼妞遇上不同受到命運捉弄的女性，不知不覺間重拾母親的角色。艾慕杜華不忘向經典電影致敬，在豐富色彩中刻畫真摯動人的相互扶持，編織出愛與重生的美麗華袍，交出一封致全世界女性的動人情書。bc配合電影公映，更特別舉辦「慾望無限――論盡艾慕杜華」作品展。

cast: Cecilia Roth, Marisa Paredes, Penélope Cruz, Candela Peña
